Maya: Quick design review — Network prereq step in Private setup wizard. QA reported users don't understand the orange 'Partial' state vs red 'Fail'. Mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz Need copy + a11y check before tomorrow's sync. Thoughts? Sam: Saw the mock. We currently render statuses as icons + short labels. Can do copy tweaks. Is the desired behavior to keep 'Retry' inline or show a single CTA? Ash: Copy suggestions: 1) Pending -> 'Verifying connectivity…' 2) Partial -> 'Limited access detected' 3) Failed -> 'Connection blocked — action required' Keep verbs present tense. Prefer 'Retry check' for primary action. Priya: A11y nits: when status changes, screen readers should be informed. Use role='status' and aria-live='polite' on the status container. Also ensure the 'More info' expander has aria-expanded and focus moves into it after open. Example: ```
Verifying connectivity…
``` Jordan: Note — backend reachability probe can take 12–20s for certain customers. Recommend we show an initial spinner + allow users to cancel. Also include exponential backoff for auto-retries so we don't thrash endpoints. Maya: Good point. UX flows: show spinner + 'Verifying connectivity…' up to 30s, then show 'Limited access detected' with two buttons: [Retry check] (primary) and [Open network docs] (secondary). 'Open network docs' should open KB in new tab. Sam: Implementing spinner + timeout ok. For keyboard users, ensure that when the 'Details' drawer appears, focus goes to the header. We'll need an accessible skip link? :thinking: Priya: Skip link suggestion: when the details panel opens, call focus() on the first heading and set aria-hidden=true on the main form. Also add 'aria-live' text updates for the retry result. Ash: Shorten helplink copy to 'See troubleshooting steps' instead of 'Open network docs' to match other flows. Maya: Agreement: use 'Retry check' (primary) + 'See troubleshooting steps' (secondary). Add a small 'Why this matters' toggle under the status with 1–2 lines explaining: 'We need control-plane connectivity for secrets, model pull, and telemetry.' Jordan: Also recommend we log explicit telemetry events for 'network_check_retry' and 'network_check_timeout' for Optimize dashboards. integration-bot: tests/network-step-focus-test — PASSED :white_check_mark: Sam: I'll open a PR with copy + aria changes, pinging @Priya for a11y review. ETA EOD. Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update the figma and add the copy variants. :eyes:
